# Lakeside Ink & Threadz

> Custom embroidery, DTF (direct-to-film) printing, business branding, logo design, and promotional items based in Livingston, TX (Lake Livingston area). Serving Livingston, Onalaska, Coldspring, Point Blank, Trinity, Huntsville, Cleveland, Splendora, Lufkin, and the surrounding East Texas area (40-mile radius).

## Quick facts

- **Name:** Lakeside Ink & Threadz (also "L.I.T.")
- **Phone:** (346) 988-5449 — call or text
- **Email:** hello@lakesidethreadz.com
- **Location:** Twin Creeks Dr, Livingston, Texas 77351
- **Hours:** Mon–Fri 9am–7pm · Sat by appointment · Sun closed
- **Turnaround:** typical orders ship in 5–10 business days; rush available for time-sensitive projects
- **Minimums:** none — single-piece orders welcome, with volume discounts starting at 12 pieces
- **What we do:** embroidery on hats / polos / work shirts / uniforms / bags / patches; DTF printing for full-color shirt designs; logo design and digitizing; branded merch for businesses, teams, churches, weddings, and events

## How pricing works

Pricing depends on garment (with three tiers: Basic workhorse, Premium everyday, Pro performance/workwear), quantity (volume discounts starting at 12 pieces), decoration method (DTF print or embroidery), and placement count. Ask for a real quote via /quote — Kristen writes every reply by hand and returns actual numbers within one business day, not a machine estimate.

## How to order

1. Request a quote at [/quote](https://lakesidethreadz.com/quote), or describe your project on [/contact](https://lakesidethreadz.com/contact).
2. Kristen replies with a real price (usually same day, always within one business day) and sends a free digital proof for approval.
3. After proof approval, production starts; typical turnaround 5–10 business days.
4. Pickup in Livingston or local delivery available.
